note: Slot 1 as planned: the needle (the fingers unchanged), the company's verdict wry and loud, Ash brings the stick (not Rae's hazel), the bridge, a miller names him and he does not turn his head (c06.8b), Rae reads the line before him (thread 3), Darrow says why first (paying the Between-1 promise of ch06) and asks for the bridge kept open; nobody sleeps. Thread 5 touched by memory (Look. Remember it.). T4 planted without the word: shapes at the field's edge, one stepping out as if remembering how. Wren cool after the choice and warmed by the dog; she counts the shapes. c05.13a (holds the far end) left for Monday's act. The miller is unnamed.
next_must_know: Monday opens in the night on the bridge: carts crossing one at a time under lamps, Darrow on the stick at the near end, his arm sewn, the shapes in the field walking out. The miller has agreed to keep the bridge open past the dusk bell; Wren is counting carts and the shapes; nobody has said the word.

note: c07.1: Rae +2. The game name-the-load (Resolve 12, partial: right about the loom, missed the old woman under it; the cost a laugh and a line Wren will hear, callback c07.1a). He asked for something for himself, not the company, and she named it a walk. Kept clear of slot 4 (her hands, her father, the question): nothing of them here.

Slot 2 rewritten 11/17 on the tentative rule (world.md, The Hollowed: hands and cold; daylight walkers, dark hunters; light holds them, small flames gutter; no water). Shown before the fire: the turn toward a person, the grip, the frost-white wrist, a lamp holding one for ten breaths. On the bridge they take hold of the stick and of him; Wren's lamps buy fewer breaths each time (Might DC 16, success: he holds, hands numb, no lasting hurt). The miller and his wife fire the mill on purpose as the one flame big enough; every face turns to it. What holds in every tier only: every cart over, the mill burned. Open for Sunday's tier: what the fire's end and the dawn cost. The word still unsaid on the page. The ring planted; the beat choice's costs shown. c05.13a and c07.1a fired.
next_must_know: Tuesday opens at the burned mill at first light on his answer to the millers, in a clause: with daylight the line on the bridge are walkers again and drift off east along the far bank (the rule in world.md). The woman's frosted wrist is Maelis's to answer at dawn. Darrow's hands were numb from the stick and are his own. Rae's cart still bars the bridge until they go.

note: c07.3: Hollis +2, Maelis +1, Wren +2, Rae +1. He asked for nobody's blessing and gave each a charge; Hollis given the forty (his need: to be needed for what he can still do), Maelis the meaning of what he finds (her need: not to be the only one holding the truth), Wren the morning count (echo of the far cots and his column). Rae asked nothing and answered nothing: her north-side advice is practical and leaves her own choice open (c07.2b still waits). His unspoken third reason (the rider's road, the man who sent her) touches thread 1. Slot 3 bent: it now opens at first light on his leaving in a clause.

Slot 3 as re-planned: the dawn turns the line into walkers (they leave downstream along the far bank); the column north under Hollis; Maelis on the wrist only 'warmer'; the road west in summary (fold, rick, cottage, no birds, noon frost in the prints). The first night by the rule: stragglers come to the fire's edge and stand; Vigor DC 13 failed: he slept, one held his boot (right foot numb, temporary, nothing to the knee), Ash woke him. Rae arrives unasked with a lamp held high through them and wood; her once-line. Not yet said on the page: she left Hob and Dun with Wren. c07.2a and c07.2b fired. No running on the page (Knot IV waits for Maelis's word).
next_must_know: Wednesday opens at the fire in the small hours or at first light with Rae there, the wood hers, his right foot coming back slowly; she says where Hob and Dun are (with Wren) when asked. The far point (the frosted field-stone) and the Tether's stage 2 at the second night's fire are Wednesday's.

note: Between at the first night's fire (c07.4). Kept off the page: her hands, her father, the cage, her question about the fast road and anything at the second night's fire (slot 4's Tether stage 2). On the page now: Hob and Dun went north with Wren. He let himself be carried for a night (his need) without remark.
next_must_know: c07.4a: he slept the back half of the night while Rae kept the fire on her oak; the scene opens at first light with that, the stragglers gone with the dark, his foot back but tender.

note: Slot 4 as planned (Tether II, a hand). Opened on c07.4a (glimpse echoes: 'only when you're warm'). The far point: a crossroads field-stone, frost at noon, the swathe braiding west of it; T1 plant, nothing usable, he says so; turned back with half a day in hand (held). Second fire: nothing came; Rae's palms, the cage, her father, the splice gone quiet (she heard it go quiet and took it for settled: the hurt she has shown nobody); worn smooth = Maelis's softest/quiet, noticed by Darrow; the script's second line thicker. Her question, with Oswin as her evidence. Micro opened. Nothing of the uncle's paying for rope/cage or anything of thread 18.
next_must_know: His answer to her question opens slot 5 in a clause (or his own words if he gives them). Slot 5: the third day back past the burned mill by noon.

threads.who_knows: Maelis keeps the chip and suspects (T1); Darrow has seen the rest of the stone in the wall under the row, the censer's black, and (07:s4) with Rae a roadside field-stone white with frost at noon where the walkers' braided roads gather; the reader.
threads.note: 07:s4: a crossroads field-stone with frost at noon; the walkers' roads braid west of it and run east from it as one; Ash would not go near it; his frost-kept fingers ached. Nothing he can use yet.
